fields.description: Personal income tax withheld from the official part of the salary.
fields.label: PIT Rate

fields.description: Military levy withheld from the official part of the salary.
fields.label: Military Levy Rate

fields.description: SSC paid on top of the official part. It is not withheld from the employee.
fields.label: SSC Rate

fields.description: Reduced SSC rate for an employee with a disability group. It applies to any group and needs the MSEC certificate on file.
fields.label: SSC Rate for Disability

fields.description: The statutory minimum wage. The reservation thresholds are multiples of it. Sick pay is capped by 20 minimum wages a month, and by one when the insurance tenure is under 6 months; an average taken from the salary is never below it.
fields.label: Minimum Wage

fields.description: How many minimum wages a reserved employee must be paid, and the company on average: 3 by Cabinet Resolution No. 76 (from 1 September 2026), 2.5 for the frontline territories.
fields.label: Reservation: Minimum Wages

fields.description: Leave empty: the minimum is the minimum wage multiplied by the number above. Fill in only to override the calculated amount.
fields.label: Minimum Salary for Reservation (Override)

fields.description: Leave empty: by law the company average must reach the same minimum as a reserved employee. Fill in only to override.
fields.label: Minimum Company Average Salary (Override)
